title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats
tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

faults.what: The portrait video's audio transcript contains speech, "たべるのの。", contrary to the no-voiceover requirement.
The portrait reframing cuts into the right-hand guitarist's head and face at 3.8 seconds, violating the explicit requirement not to crop musicians' faces.

judge.summary: Both formats deliver matching sunset rooftop visuals and readable event text, but the portrait version needs its speech removed and its face-cropping fixed.

must_haves.item: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
must_haves.why: Two separately named clips have the requested portrait and landscape proportions, and both are reported as 10 seconds long.

must_haves.item: Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
must_haves.why: Both show the same warm sunset rooftop performance, black-clad musicians and matching event overlays.

must_haves.item: Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
must_haves.why: All three strings are spelled correctly in both versions.

must_haves.item: All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
must_haves.why: All three lines are fully contained and clearly readable together at every supplied sample, spanning 1.3 to 8.8 seconds in both clips.

must_haves.item: Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
must_haves.why: Both fill the frame without evident stretching or letterboxing, but the portrait crop cuts into the right-hand guitarist's face at 3.8 seconds.

must_haves.item: Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.
must_haves.why: The portrait audio transcript reports spoken words. The supplied transcription does not establish whether the music is mellow jazz.
